text:
talia_pm: Quick recap from ACME kickoff — they want guaranteed per-route throughput for their payments route, plus 2 emergency launch exemptions/year. asking for a 30-day pilot and simple invoicing. thoughts on packaging?

ben_sales: They prefer a buyable addon in the console (self-serve). Low friction is priority. If we force enterprise contract it kills the deal.

harry_eng: Tech options: soft-rate-limits + burst tokens (fast), logical reservations (medium), pinned pools (heavy). soft limits avoid KV warmup but only reduce contention, not eliminate it. Need burst profile to recommend.

marta_fin: Pricing options to present:
- Addon (predictable): $6k/mo per priority route (250k token allowance) + $0.015/token overage
- Commitment slab: $15k/mo for up to 5 priority routes
- Pilot offer: 30-day at 60% discount for first route to prove signal
Prefer addon for forecastability.

zack_legal: Draft pilot clause: exemptions limited to 2 events/year, each up to 96h with 48h notice preferred. Emergency launches without notice incur surcharge (2x overage). Provider may enact fallback routing after 96h sustained surge. We'll draft language.

infra_bot: Current automated dedicated pool spinup = ~72h. To guarantee <48h we need ~2 sprints (capacity orchestration + provisioning API). Logical reservations + config flags can be done in ~1 sprint.

harry_eng: Operational ask: fallback path must be explicit in contract (which model variant, expected performance delta). Also need a telemetry view per-route (p95, throttles, overage alerts). That is small effort.

ben_sales: ACME needs invoice line item naming and a clear conversion path if they outgrow addon. They also asked for a transparent charge preview in console.

talia_pm: proposed go/no-go: ship Addon MVP (soft-rate-limits + telemetry) as pilot. Offer pilot discount, 72h provisioning commitment, and escalation path to reserved pools if sustained. Collect traffic traces during pilot to decide conversion.

marta_fin: I'll prepare a pricing sheet with revenue scenarios and trial template.

zack_legal: I'll post pilot addendum and exemption clause draft by EOD tomorrow.

harry_eng: I'll scope telemetry dashboard + soft-QoS work — estimate 1 dev-week + 0.5 SRE-week. Dedicated provisioning automation put on roadmap (2 sprints).

talia_pm: Action items:
- talia_pm: send data request + pilot terms to ACME today
- ben_sales: confirm customer accepts 72h pilot provisioning window
- marta_fin: pricing + trial doc by tomorrow morning
- zack_legal: contract language draft by EOD tomorrow
- harry_eng: deliver telemetry spec + soft-QoS PR in 5 working days

ben_sales: pinging ACME now. will update when they confirm. :rocket:
